name: delete a root-protected file via an escalated command
definition: Remove a file that the current user cannot touch directly, using escalated capabilities.
failure_mode: File remaining in place fails the existence check.

name: deny access to users outside the target group
definition: configure the base and default 'other' columns with no permissions so non-members cannot list/create/read in the hierarchy.
failure_mode: too-permissive default/base bits let outside users in and fail the denial checks

name: derive a feasible meeting choice from preference, schedule, and commute
definition: Combine dietary preference, working hours, and commute to pick a venue matching everyone and still open in the window.
failure_mode: Choosing a venue with a timing conflict fails the constraint check.

name: derive event boundaries from motion/trajectory heuristics of the foreground object
definition: Infer airborne phase from vertical motion or displacement patterns of the tracked subject to pin down takeoff and landing instants.
failure_mode: Blurred airborne period or occlusion shifts detected instants off range
